summary_en: SBI NM合同会社 (SBI Holdings subsidiary vehicle) to conduct public tender offer for all ordinary shares of BASE Inc. (TSE Growth, 4477). Tender price: ¥2,940/share. Acquisition period: Aug 31 – Sep 30, 2026 (20 business days). Target: equity method associate status. SBI Holdings simultaneously executes capital and business partnership agreement with BASE.
title_en: Notice Concerning Commencement of Public Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of BASE Inc. (Securities Code: 4477) and Execution of Capital and Business Partnership Agreement
translation_en_brief: SBI Holdings (via its wholly-owned subsidiary SBIER and the special-purpose vehicle SBI NM合同会社) announced on 28 August 2026 the commencement of a public tender offer for all ordinary shares of BASE Inc. (TSE Growth, ticker 4477). The tender price is ¥2,940 per share. The offer will run from 31 August to 30 September 2026, covering 20 business days. The stated objective is to acquire BASE to establish it as an equity-method associate company (持分法適用関連会社). Simultaneously, SBI Holdings entered into a capital and business partnership agreement with BASE. The filing indicates this transaction is executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours matching system). No specific share count or percentage of shares outstanding was disclosed in the excerpted pages; the aggregate acquisition cost is approximately ¥14.3 billion based on the disclosed tender price. The offeror is a special-purpose vehicle established by SBI Holdings, with the latter acting as ultimate decision-maker and capital provider.
